ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a horizontally extending chain, composed of multiple circular rings interlinked with one another. The leftmost circular ring is marked with inner radius 2 cm and outer radius 3 cm. The double-headed arrow below measures from the leftmost outer edge of the first circular ring all the way to the rightmost outer edge of the last circular ring, marked with total length 1.7 m. Adjacent circular rings are interlinked with one another as shown in the figure, and the chain approximately extends along a straight line. Reasoning: Convert 1.7 m to 170 cm. The first circular ring contributes one outer diameter from the left outer edge to the right outer edge, namely 2 × 3 = 6 cm. According to the specified center-spacing model, each added circular ring increases the chain length by the inner diameter of the previous circular ring, namely 2 × 2 = 4 cm. If there are n circular rings in total, then the total length is 6 + 4(n - 1) = 170. Solving gives 4(n - 1) = 164, n - 1 = 41, so n = 42.

raw_record.question_text: A chain is made from circular links with external radius $3 \mathrm{~cm}$ and internal radius $2 \mathrm{~cm}$. When the rings are linked together as shown in the diagram, the length of the chain is $1.7 \mathrm{~m}$. How many rings are used?

method.method_draft: Use a center-spacing model. From the image, read that the links form a straight horizontal chain, with the total measured length running from the leftmost outside edge of the first ring to the rightmost outside edge of the last ring. The diagram shows adjacent circular links interlocked so that each new ring advances the chain by the internal diameter of the previous ring. From the text, take external radius 3 cm, internal radius 2 cm, and total length 1.7 m = 170 cm. The first ring contributes its full outside diameter, 2·3 = 6 cm. Each additional ring adds one inner diameter, 2·2 = 4 cm. Set 6 + 4(n - 1) = 170 and solve to get n = 42.

推理：将 1.7 m 化为 170 cm。第一个圆环从左外边缘到右外边缘贡献一个外直径，即 2 × 3 = 6 cm。按指定的中心间距模型，每增加一个圆环，链长增加前一个圆环的内直径，即 2 × 2 = 4 cm。若共有 n 个圆环，则总长度为 6 + 4(n - 1) = 170。解得 4(n - 1) = 164，n - 1 = 41，所以 n = 42。

method.method_draft: Use an overlap-subtraction count. From the image, read that the chain consists of identical circular annuli placed in a repeating overlapping pattern, with the full horizontal chain length marked as 1.7 m. From the text, the outside diameter of each ring is 2·3 = 6 cm and the inside diameter is 2·2 = 4 cm. In the shown interlocking arrangement, two adjacent outside diameters overlap horizontally by 6 - 4 = 2 cm, because the effective advance from one ring to the next is the inner diameter. For n separate rings the total of outside diameters would be 6n, but there are n - 1 overlaps of 2 cm, so the chain length is 6n - 2(n - 1) = 4n + 2. Equate 4n + 2 = 170 and solve n = 42.
